questions.stem: What is a storm caused by?
questions.solution: A storm is caused by a decrease in air pressure, which leads to rapid wind movement. The other options are incorrect as they do not explain the cause of a storm.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a correct first aid practice for a person suffering from sunstroke?
choices: Wipe their body with a wet cloth
Make them run in the sun
Cover them with a thick blanket
questions.solution: Wiping the body with a wet cloth helps lower body temperature by promoting evaporative cooling, which is essential for someone with sunstroke. Giving water to a semi-conscious person can be dangerous, as they may choke or aspirate. Running in the sun or covering with a thick blanket would trap heat and increase body temperature, worsening the condition.

questions.stem: What should farmers do when they receive weather department alerts about storms?
choices: Ignore the alerts and continue with their work
Take shelter in a safe place and close doors and windows
Step out of the house during the storm
questions.solution: Taking shelter in a safe place and closing doors and windows helps protect against the dangers of storms, such as strong winds and flying debris. Ignoring alerts puts lives at risk, spreading rumors is unhelpful and misleading, and stepping out during a storm increases the likelihood of injury.

questions.stem: If a person's clothes catch fire, what should be done immediately?
choices: Run to the nearest water source
Roll on the ground to put out the fire
Use a fan to blow out the flames
questions.solution: Rolling on the ground suffocates the fire by cutting off its oxygen supply, which is the most effective immediate action. Using a fan or running can increase the fire's intensity by providing more oxygen. A fire extinguisher is not typically accessible in such situations and is not the first step to take.

questions.stem: A student observes that the particles of a substance are very close and hold on to each other tightly. What will be the state of the substance?
questions.solution: When particles are very close and hold on to each other tightly, the substance is in the solid state because the strong forces between particles keep them in a fixed position. Liquids have particles that are close but can slide past each other, gases have particles that are far apart and move freely, and plasma consists of ionized particles that are not bound together.

hi.stem: एक छात्र देखता है कि किसी पदार्थ के कण बहुत करीब हैं और एक दूसरे को तान कर रखते हैं। पदार्थ की स्थिति क्या होगी?
hi.solution: जब कण बहुत करीब होते हैं और एक दूसरे को तान कर रखते हैं, तो पदार्थ ठोस अवस्था में होता है क्योंकि कणों के बीच की मजबूत बल उन्हें निश्चित स्थिति में रखते हैं। तरल में कण निकट होते हैं लेकिन एक दूसरे के पास सरक सकते हैं, गैस में कण दूर होते हैं और मुक्त रूप से गति करते हैं, और प्लाज्मा में आयनित कण होते हैं जो एक दूसरे से बंधे नहीं रहते।
hi.critique: Translation is accurate and maintains the scientific terminology used in Hindi textbooks.

mr.solution: जेव्हा कण खूप जवळ असतात आणि एकमेकांस खूप काठीत धरून ठेवतात, तेव्हा पदार्थ कठिण अवस्थेत असतो कारण कणांमधील शक्ती त्यांना निश्चित स्थानावर ठेवतात. द्रवांमध्ये कण जवळ असतात परंतु एकमेकांच्या बरोबर फिसके जाऊ शकतात, वायूमध्ये कण दूर असतात आणि स्वतंत्रपणे चालू शकतात, आणि प्लाज्मामध्ये आयनीकृत कण असतात जे एकमेकांस बांधलेले नसतात.
mr.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate Marathi scientific terminology.

questions.stem: What happens when the epicenter of an earthquake is on the ocean floor?
choices: Massive waves called tsunamis are created
The water in the ocean boils violently
The earthquake is felt only in the ocean
questions.solution: When an earthquake occurs with its epicenter on the ocean floor, the movement of the seafloor displaces a large volume of water, creating massive waves known as tsunamis. The other options are incorrect because water does not boil due to an earthquake, the ocean does not become still, and the earthquake's effects are felt on land as well as in the ocean.

hi.solution: जब भूकंप का अपकेंद्र समुद्र के तल पर होता है तो समुद्रतल के गति के कारण बड़ी मात्रा में पानी के विस्थापन के कारण ज्वारमुखी के रूप में जानी जाने वाली बड़ी लहरें बनती हैं। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि भूकंप के कारण पानी नहीं उबलता है, समुद्र शांत नहीं होता है और भूकंप के प्रभाव भूमि पर भी महसूस किए जाते हैं।

questions.stem: What is the main reason for avoiding crowding at the site of a major accident?
choices: To make space for emergency vehicles
questions.solution: The main reason for avoiding crowding at the site of a major accident is to prevent further accidents. Crowds can obstruct emergency responders and increase the risk of additional injuries. Making space for emergency vehicles is important but not the primary concern, and taking photos or disturbing victims are not the main scientific reasons for avoiding crowding.

hi.solution: एक गंभीर दुर्घटना के स्थल पर भीड़ बनाने से बचने का मुख्य कारण अतिरिक्त दुर्घटनाओं को रोकना है। भीड़ आपातकालीन प्रतिक्रिया कर्मियों को अवरुद्ध कर सकती है और अतिरिक्त चोटों के जोखिम को बढ़ा सकती है। आपातकालीन वाहनों के लिए जगह बनाना महत्वपूर्ण है लेकिन मुख्य चिंता नहीं है, और फोटो खींचने या घायलों को बर्बाद करना भीड़ बनाने से बचने के मुख्य वैज्ञानिक कारण नहीं हैं।

questions.stem: What can happen if a river's course changes after an earthquake?
choices: It will always lead to a drought
It can cause floods in some areas and droughts in others
It can cause landslides in nearby hills
It will always lead to a flood
questions.solution: When a river's course changes due to an earthquake, it can disrupt the natural flow of water, leading to areas receiving too much water (floods) and others receiving too little (droughts). Landslides may occur due to the shaking, but they are not a direct result of the river's new course. Droughts and floods are not guaranteed in all cases, so the idea that it will 'always' lead to either is incorrect.

hi.stem: एक भूकंप के बाद एक नदी के मार्ग में परिवर्तन हो सकता है तो क्या हो सकता है?
choices: इसके परिणामस्वरूप हमेशा एक सूखा होगा
इसके परिणामस्वरूप कुछ क्षेत्रों में बाढ़ हो सकती है और अन्य में सूखा हो सकता है
इसके परिणामस्वरूप आसपास के पहाड़ों में भूस्खलन हो सकता है
इसके परिणामस्वरूप हमेशा एक बाढ़ होगी
hi.solution: जब एक भूकंप के कारण एक नदी के मार्ग में परिवर्तन होता है, तो यह पानी के प्राकृतिक प्रवाह को बाधित कर सकता है, जिसके परिणामस्वरूप कुछ क्षेत्रों में पानी की अधिक मात्रा (बाढ़) और अन्य क्षेत्रों में कम मात्रा (सूखा) हो सकती है। भूकंप के कारण भूस्खलन हो सकता है, लेकिन यह नदी के नए मार्ग का सीधा परिणाम नहीं है। सूखा और बाढ़ हमेशा निश्चित नहीं होते हैं, इसलिए 'हमेशा' के रूप में किसी एक के लिए निश्चित होने का विचार गलत है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the original English question and solution, with appropriate terminology and logical structure.

questions.stem: If a factory experiences an accident due to improper handling of chemicals, what is the most appropriate action to prevent such incidents in the future?
choices: Ignore safety regulations to save costs
questions.solution: Providing regular training to workers ensures they understand how to handle chemicals safely, reducing the risk of accidents. Ignoring safety regulations and using faulty machinery increase dangers, while avoiding chemical storage is not always feasible or practical.
